name: B47ANCE'd UI

features.text: Public Lua client API 1: styled native controls, renderer, layout, dialogs, focus and bounded tooltips.
Near-black shared surfaces, grey default accent and instance-rounded corners; explicit Small/Normal button helpers preserve existing geometry and native callbacks. Legacy Large calls alias Normal.
Separate large-text MenuButton component for consumer-owned main/pause-style navigation; transparent backing, no button frame, label-only scoped accent hover/controller focus.

Native main/Esc navigation adapter: large text with scoped accent hover/controller underline, preserving native label identities, actions, visibility, controller rows (the separate background adapter lays out the main-menu column). No global class override or tick scan.

Security-room main menu: four independent 1-60 second static startups then persistent no-signal loops; enlarged centered labels with visible direct mod-entry discovery and responsive rows, retaining callbacks. Menu/logo width is capped before the outer CRT casing for long translations/mod labels; standard 4:3/16:9 through 4K and 21:9/32:9 viewport fixtures pass offline.
Main-menu-only runtime music gain mute; saved options unchanged and native exit restores configured gain. Audible rain/thunder suppression NOT TESTED.

Continuous security room expanded to the right: desk reframed toward center-left, one wall/pipe/baseboard/floor perspective and lamp, uniform cover scaling through 32:9 with four transparent CRTs and a separate left menu. PZ runtime NOT TESTED.
Bunker/security artwork decoration: right filing cabinets, archive boxes, noticeboard, key rack, intercom/extinguisher; low footlocker/vent at far left with menu area clear.

Dev.11 selected pipe artwork: existing horizontal conduit extends across the left wall; logo/menu center405, wallY116-470/right600, cropfocus680 and measured CRT masks. User-selected PNG unchanged; standard/ultrawide offline tests, native rendering NOT TESTED.

Local main-menu layout editor: independent menu/logo move/resize, aspect lock, native percentage sliders and Save/Cancel/Reset. Normalized schema1 preferences; F10/controller X access, capture/focus cleanup and dynamic mod-entry fitting. Offline tests only; native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Native Options/settings presentation: near-black backdrop, rounded tab/button surfaces, active-tab underline and existing local accent. Instance-only palette/drawing retains native fonts/geometry/callbacks/options, page stencil and input ownership; custom renderers and swatches guarded, shared dropdown temporary palette restores. Native acceptance NOT TESTED.

Optional PZOPT_MENU title/status adapter: shared centered menu title, reserved live version/update line beneath, aligned controller glyph and original callback/render/status ownership; no external dependency or code reuse. Native integration NOT TESTED.
In-game hex/RGB accent editor with live scoped preview, per-consumer/local-player persistence, opacity-only migration and reset to grey.
Consumer/player scoped local appearance with legacy import, lazy appearance editor and original clipboard drawing.
Live CCTV camera feeds, full vanilla UI overhaul and general window-layout editing remain unimplemented.

Public Workshop MP test item 3822582242 updated to 0.5.0-dev.11 after PR 14, with 52-file source/ZIP/stage parity, SteamCMD commit-success and exact public description. Steam unchanged by user choice; native/dedicated NOT TESTED.

limits: 0.6.0-dev.2 development source; Workshop remains 0.5.0-dev.11. Menu layout and native-settings contract doubles PASS offline. Settings retain native display/audio/keybinding logic by source; no engine options/input validation. Native drawing, keyboard/controller/focus, file reload, resolution changes, provider integration and performance NOT TESTED. G6 NOT TESTED; G7/stable G8 BLOCKED. No deployment/launch/package/upload. No gameplay authority or shared sandbox configuration.
